Multi-Tier Defense

Our 5-Stage Quality Inspection Process

Rigorous testing protocols ensure only the purest grains make it into every export bag.

01
Farmer Field Inward

Raw paddy sampled for moisture, grain maturity, and absence of prohibited pesticides before gate unloading.

02
Destoning & Cleaning

Multi-deck vibrating screens and rare-earth magnetic separators remove mud balls, weed seeds, and metallic particles.

03
Buhler Sortex Scan

High-speed optical cameras scan 100% of grains in free-fall, ejecting chalky, broken, yellowed, or damaged kernels.

04
In-House Lab Release

Laboratory test for raw grain length (AGL), moisture, cooking test, elongation ratio, and whiteness level.

05
SGS Container Stuffing

Independent international inspectors verify cargo condition, supervise bag loading, and affix tamper-proof customs seals.
